limitations: Partial SKU capture on large nodes: batteries-gen-duty captured 20 of 146; filter leaves captured first-100 samples (engine-oil 914, fuel 831, air 1200, hydraulic 663). node.sku_count is the TRUE total; skus[] for these nodes is a sample - recall keys on them are lower bounds, not full keys.

GET subcategories captured at taxonomy level only (name + true sku_count, no SKUs): the part-number-heavy head of the catalog (hundreds-thousands each) that browser-eval cannot exhaustively read. Used for category vocabulary and to show part-number/serial demand is not answer-key-generable.

Facet values NOT captured: spec facets (Cold Cranking Amps, Voltage on batteries; dimensional specs elsewhere) render client-side behind Filter & Sort. facet_provenance=unknown pending a facet-rail read.
15 top-level category landing pages omitted as nodes; their names carry into the authored query seed list (stage 2).
Browser-only: parts.cat.com is behind Caterpillar Akamai; server-side/WebFetch reads time out. Pagination beyond ~100 SSR tiles is client-side AJAX, not URL params.
